|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Jedi Survivor (V)]]; it is the current version. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints destiny 3 with the same game text. The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip prints the original destiny 1; see [[Jedi Survivor (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Jedi Survivor (V)]]): Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; the surviving sheet copy was re-made 1 April 2010; slip 41) — destiny '''1'''. Game text: “When deployed, you may not initiate battle here this turn. While at opponent’s site, adds one [Light Side Force] and one [Dark Side Force]. May ‘swing’ lightsabers for free. May never be won in sabacc. Immune to attrition < 5. End of your turn: [Use Force] Use 1 or [Lose Force] Lose 1 or [Place out of play].”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 7, 2009"), page 5, slip 41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): destiny '''3''', game text unchanged. The Players Committee announced this errata (“This card is destiny 3.”) on its rules forum on 27 July 2010, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p568455">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 27 July 2010 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=0#p568455 forum post])</ref>, so destiny 3 dates from then; the Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints it.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014), page 9. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image [[:File:VB5-L-jedisurvivor-pre.gif]] also prints destiny 3 with the same text, but is undated (its earliest Internet Archive capture is from 2018). The PC website card list (2012–13) shows no destiny number; its game text only writes out the maintenance icons (“End of turn: Use 1 to maintain OR Lose 1 Force to place in Used Pile OR Place out of play.”), which is icon notation, not a version.<ref name="cl-1250_41">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> A stat-only change counts as a version (Bill's wiki versions ruling, November 2026).
